evidence_limits: Catalog purpose and philosophy are authored intent, not observed capability, installation, release, customer acceptance, revenue, or agent status.
The four current founder directions take precedence for catalog intent; the older PRD files are preserved byte for byte.
Repository paths are relative to the explicitly configured serving workspace root. Current presence must be checked by that runtime.

Source revisions identify the recovered git HEAD in recovery/recovered-source-manifest.json, not local patch modifications. All fifteen origin/revision values also match the retained earlier source-manifest values.
Library identities are successful historical upload receipts and are metadata only. No current Library browser URLs are declared.
The packaged copies preserve source bytes and Library identity; no live Library version synchronization was performed.
LunaNexa remains infrastructure outside this twenty-product catalog.

Reconstructed after workspace reset from surviving PRD inputs and retained task/tool content. Missing historical proposal hashes were not guessed; provenance changes require a new catalog hash and fresh verification.

founder_direction_capture.provenance: Current founder direction retained in the authorized implementation task and its MoonProj purpose clarification. Reconstructed after the cloud workspace reset from the completed task's retained tool-call and task-message content.
founder_direction_capture.unavailable_source: The original product-registry-next.md bytes and historical SHA were not recovered. No proposal hash or old-byte identity is asserted.

moonproj.heading: Top-down management
moonproj.direction: Product philosophy and PRDs guide goals, bounded work, decisions, and concrete working results across the product landscape. Management can run autonomously; human inspection and intervention remain available when wanted. Existing task acceptance semantics remain separate.

moondesk.heading: Quick prototyping and human interleaving
moondesk.direction: A place for a person to inspect, intervene, and iteratively shape work and prototypes.

moontown.heading: Bottom-up reuse and emergence
moontown.direction: Repeated local work can reveal reusable patterns and broader coordination opportunities.

moonbook.heading: Experienced agent and memory
moonbook.direction: Accumulated experience and durable memory support continuity and better future work.

founder_direction_capture.evidence_limit: These are authored product intentions. They do not assert implementation maturity or change execution, approval, or acceptance authority.

reconstruction.reason_for_new_hash: The lost proposal hash in the founder provenance cannot be verified. Founder text is retained, with explicitly reconstructed provenance and a new source hash.
